anti-censorship.title: Anti-censorship
anti-censorship.intro: Enable these features if you're experiencing connection issues or NymVPN is blocked in your location.

quic.label: Enhanced connection (QUIC)
quic.content:
Improves the Fast mode reliability in restrictive networks by wrapping WireGuard traffic in QUIC (HTTP/3) to appear as regular web browsing.

Note: Limits entry server options to QUIC-compatible gateways only.

stealth-api.label: Stealth API connect
stealth-api.content: Disguises API requests behind popular, allowed domains to bypass VPN blocking. Automatically used by NymVPN when standard connection attempts fail.
stealth-api.link: How the Stealth API connect mode works

logout-confirmation.title: Are you sure?
logout-confirmation.description: You will need your access code to reconnect your device.

error-monitoring.label: Error & crash reports
error-monitoring.sublabel: Changes will apply after app and daemon restart.
error-monitoring.desc: Send crash info to help us fix bugs faster. Reports go through Sentry's secure system and include technical debugging data only.

network-stats.label: Anonymous network stats
network-stats.sublabel: Changes will apply after daemon restart.
network-stats.desc:
Help us build a faster network by sharing anonymous performance data from your region. We use this to optimize speeds, reduce disconnections, and steer server coverage where it's needed most.

Only network performance data is shared - never your browsing activity or personal data.
